segments.t: Behind closed doors, Andrea, Gabriel, and Arlette brainstorm frantically to neutralize the American studio's lawsuit. Determined to break Mathias's leverage before he announces his takeover, Andrea conceives an audacious scheme: finding a namesake to claim she played the disputed role. When Arlette suggests casting the stranger as a ghost, an eccentric plan is born. Let's listen to the scene in French first.

Nous devons contrer les Américains avant lui.
